ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $D$ is a point on $AB$, $E$ is the midpoint of $AC$, $DE$ is extended to point $F$ such that $EF=ED$, and $CF$ is drawn. $CF\parallel AB$. If $\angle A=70^\circ$, $\angle F=35^\circ$, and $BE\perp AC$, what is the degree measure of $\angle BED$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: From (1) we know that $\angle A = \angle ACF$,\\
$\therefore \angle ACF = \angle A = 70^\circ$,\\
Additionally, since $\angle F = 35^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle DEC = \angle F + \angle ACF = 70^\circ + 35^\circ = 105^\circ$\\
Also, since $BE \perp AC$\\
$\therefore \angle BEC = 90^\circ$\\
Thus, $\angle BED = \angle DEC - \angle BEC = 105^\circ - 90^\circ = \boxed{15^\circ}$.
